title: Asset-heavy repos: KB edge should run near ceiling — floor≈ceiling for opaque assets
summary: User insight + bracket-model prediction: the measured 14%(floor)→57%(ceiling) KB-earned gap exists because CODE is self-recoverable by reading. For non-code assets (textures, 3D models, audio, spritesheets) a text agent cannot recover the semantics/rationale by reading — so for asset-domain knowledge, floor≈ceiling and the KB edge should run near the 57%+ ceiling EVEN when the agent has full repo access. Game/asset-heavy repos are majority-opaque → blended KB value far higher than on pure-code repos. Differentiated product story: 'the agent knows your assets, not just your code.' Test plan: make /13 (verify-on-different-repo, still open) target an ASSET-HEAVY game repo; split probes into code-domain vs asset-domain; prediction = cold-rate craters on asset probes even with repo access. Needs: light asset miners (naming/tree conventions, metadata stats, asset churn from git, asset→code reference grep), asset-domain probes; harness/judge/learner KEEP criterion work unchanged. Semi-readable formats (Unity YAML/.meta, Godot .tscn, JSON/CSV data tables) sit between: structure recoverable, rationale not.
